title: GameChoice
description: The games Mod Mallet knows, and which of them the user looks at.

active.description: The identifier of the game the user looks at.

games.description: Every game Mod Mallet knows, in the order they are offered.

GameSupport.description: How far Mod Mallet can look at a setup of a game.

oneOf.description: Every check Mod Mallet has runs for this game.

The load order, files, archives, plugins, placed objects, the map
and the toolbox are read; checks that need more knowledge of the
game, such as the kinds of its map's places, are still missing.

KnownGame.description: A game Mod Mallet knows, and where it is on this machine.

dir.description: The directory the game is installed in, if it was found or named.

id.description:
Identifier of the game, the same the mod manager uses, for example
`skyrimse`.

scriptExtender.description: The short name of the game's script extender, such as `SKSE`.

support.description: How far Mod Mallet can look at a setup of this game.

LocationOrigin.description: How Mod Mallet came to look at a place.

oneOf.description:
It was read from the entry the game's launcher writes into the
Windows registry.

It is the place where the game or the mod manager always puts this
file.
It was found in one of Steam's game libraries.

It was read from the entry GOG Galaxy writes into the Windows
registry.
It is named in the mod manager's record of the files it deployed.
